title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Workshop Safety
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of the following is strictly prohibited in a technology workshop to ensure safety?
options: Using tools for their intended purpose
questions.explain: Wearing loose clothing or ties is prohibited because they can get caught in moving machinery parts, leading to severe injuries.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: In the context of First Aid, what does the abbreviation 'ABC' stand for?
questions.explain: ABC stands for Airway, Breathing, and Circulation. These are the primary steps to check when attending to an unconscious victim.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: What is the primary function of a sand bucket in a workshop?
options: To extinguish small electrical or oil fires
questions.explain: Sand buckets are fire-fighting equipment used to smother small fires, particularly those involving flammable liquids or electricity where water cannot be used.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of the following Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is most appropriate for welding operations?
questions.explain: Welding produces intense light and sparks. A face shield with a darkened filter or welding goggles is necessary to protect the eyes from arc eye and the face from burns.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which class of fire involves flammable liquids such as petrol, oil, and grease?
questions.explain: Class B fires involve flammable liquids. Class A involves solids like wood/paper, Class C involves gases, and Class D involves metals.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Accidents in the workshop are often caused by 'horseplay'. What is horseplay?
questions.explain: Horseplay refers to practical jokes, pushing, or rough play in the workshop, which distracts workers and causes accidents.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which fire extinguisher color code typically represents Water?
questions.explain: Water extinguishers are typically colored Signal Red. CO2 is Black, Foam is Cream, and Dry Powder is Blue.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
